name: io.github.b84330808/mcp-server-for-bambu
title: Bambu Lab Printer (LAN)
description: Unofficial. Status, AMS filament, print control and maintenance for Bambu Lab 3D printers via LAN

environmentVariables.name: BAMBU_IP
environmentVariables.description: Printer IP on your LAN. Optional: leave all three unset and run the setup_printer tool instead.

environmentVariables.name: BAMBU_SERIAL
environmentVariables.description: Printer serial number (Settings > Device > Device Info).

environmentVariables.name: BAMBU_ACCESS_CODE
environmentVariables.description: 8-character LAN access code (Settings > WLAN > LAN Mode Liveview).

environmentVariables.name: BAMBU_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to register only read tools: no pause, cancel, heating or G-code.
